purpose: Three variations of the user's selected Recall fold concept

variants.name: 04A / Soft fold
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Input image 1: edit target and authoritative reference for the BetterFlash "Recall fold" logo.
Task: produce ONE carefully refined variation of this same logo concept. Retain its recognizable tall bookmark silhouette, V-shaped lower notch, single diagonal fold and open upper negative space. Preserve the educational, sleek, modern, professional character.
Keep the exact wordmark "BetterFlash", its monospaced typeface, placement and size. Keep the overall square specimen composition, same icon center, generous spacing and scale. Replace only the upper-left specimen caption with the exact caption below, using the reference's typography.
Palette: warm ivory #f7eee8 mark and lettering on a solid flat deep aubergine #211722 background. Crisp vector-like edges, optically balanced contours.
Avoid: copy/paste icon, overlapping rectangles, extra cards, letters within the icon, brain, cap, lightning, sparkle, face, eye, target, fish, arrowhead embellishments, extra symbols. No shadows, glow, gradient, texture, perspective or 3D. This is a flat logo specimen. Do not add descriptions, palettes, diagrams or other marks.
Change only the mark geometry as specified below and the specimen caption.
Specimen caption (verbatim): "04A / Soft fold".
Variant direction: Reduce the outline weight by approximately 20 percent for a lighter, more refined glyph. Retain the tall proportions of the reference. Refine every corner into smooth, consistent modest-radius curves; round the V notch's tip subtly. Make the top-left turn a clean continuous curve with no tiny hook or pinched gap. Keep the diagonal fold fully joined to the outer contour. Preserve broad clear negative spaces. A calm, elegant continuous-ribbon interpretation, clearly differentiated by its lighter outline.
